entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order 945-alpha-22.
Thank you, Sam. I see your order here for the VeloFit Aero-Carbon cycling shoes. Let me ask, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
They don't fit right. They're just bad.
I'm sorry to hear they aren't working out. When you say they don't fit right, can you be more specific? For example, are they too tight, or causing discomfort during your ride?
They gave me blisters on my heel after one ride. I'm not wearing them again.

I understand completely, getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I see you received the shoes just seven days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you.

Of course. I am generating a pre-paid return label for you now. I'll email it to the address we have on file. All you'll need to do is package the cycling shoes and their cleats in the original box, affix the label, and drop it off at a UPS store. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
You certainly will. I've just sent that email. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Sam?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can provide you with a better experience in the future. Have a good rest of your day.
